description: Land Acquisition - Idigaswewa, Mahadiulwewa, Nikawewa, Siyambaladamana, Huruluwewa, Kekirawa D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2234/34 of 23.04.20212050/31 of 30.01.2018
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition for a public purpose (construction of the Upper Elahera Canal). It contains detailed descriptions of specific land lots being acquired, including their locations, extents, and claimants. The notice is issued under the Land Acquisition Act and falls under "PART III — LANDS" of the gazette, making it clearly a land-related matter that fits Type 4 (Land Gazettes) classification.
